confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live listings or price pages were checked. Food and beer rest on general knowledge of Thamel and central Kathmandu price levels, projected forward to July 2026. Accommodation is the least certain, given wide spreads and monsoon-season discounting. Cocktail and wine are set from their local relationship to beer (about 2.2 and 2.0 times the beer anchor), because direct bar prices are weakly remembered. The FX row comes from web search summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page directly. The posting time of the 15 October figure could not be confirmed, and the same summaries give 0.7002 for 14 October. One search result contained an unrelated formatting instruction, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No web-sourced comparables were used. The regional basis is South Asian tourist-hub price levels, with food and drink loosely cross-checked against Southeast Asian backpacker hubs such as Hanoi, and lodging reflecting Thamel and Lazimpat guesthouse and hotel levels. Nepal's import duties on wine and spirits are reflected in the wine anchor.
